fields.name: query_id
fields.description: Stable query ID (V001-V326) preserved from the authoritative source ID file.

fields.name: query
fields.description: The literal search query text, in its original language (Chinese or English). Not translated or altered.

fields.name: language
fields.description: Language of the query (163 zh / 163 en).

fields.name: scenario
fields.description: One of four use-case scenarios the query bank was designed around.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Fine-grained category within the scenario (e.g. toy, figure).

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Free-text (Chinese) rationale for why this query was included in the bank.

fields.name: query_id
fields.description: Foreign key to queries.csv query_id.

fields.name: query
fields.description: The literal search query text (redundant with queries.csv, kept for standalone readability).

fields.name: run_variant
fields.description: Which Curify code state this row's results came from. See provenance.json / METHODOLOGY.md for exact commit SHAs.

fields.name: ok
fields.description: Whether the search request completed without a collection error.

fields.name: http_status
fields.description: HTTP status code of the search request.

fields.name: total_results
fields.description: Total result count returned (inspirations + matched templates + gallery prompts).

fields.name: inspiration_count
fields.description: Count of inspiration-type results.

fields.name: matched_template_count
fields.description: Count of matched-template-type results.

fields.name: gallery_prompt_count
fields.description: Count of gallery-prompt-type results.

fields.name: zero_result
fields.description: True when total_results == 0 (per source definition: 'totalResults === 0').

fields.name: low_result
fields.description: True when 0 < total_results < 5 (per source definition).

fields.name: rewrite_triggered
fields.description: Whether Curify's query-rewrite logic fired for this query.

fields.name: relevance_label
fields.description: LLM-judge (gpt-4o-mini, temperature 0) relevance label. Not a human judgment - see METHODOLOGY.md for the exact pass/fail/partial/unjudgable rubric.

fields.name: relevance_score
fields.description: Numeric relevance score (0-100 scale as coded in the source judge rubric) underlying the relevance_label.

fields.name: primary_failure_reason
fields.description: LLM-judge's stated primary reason for a non-PASS label, when applicable.

fields.name: semantic_drift
fields.description: LLM-judge's assessment of semantic drift from the original query intent (e.g. MINOR, SEVERE).

fields.name: original_intent_preserved
fields.description: LLM-judge's assessment of whether the original query intent was preserved (e.g. YES, PARTIALLY, NO).

fields.name: judgeable_count
fields.description: Number of top-5 results the LLM judge was able to score.

fields.name: relevant_count
fields.description: Number of top-5 results judged relevant.

fields.name: partial_count
fields.description: Number of top-5 results judged partially relevant.

fields.name: irrelevant_count
fields.description: Number of top-5 results judged irrelevant.

fields.name: top5_titles
fields.description: JSON-array-formatted string of the top 5 result titles.

fields.name: query_id
fields.description: Foreign key to queries.csv query_id.

fields.name: query
fields.description: The literal search query text.

fields.name: human_verdict
fields.description: A single reviewer's verdict for this query, recorded against the candidate_2026-07-22_0e794cd9 run. Preserved exactly as written, including non-standard uncertainty markers ('PASS?', a full-width variant, and 'PARTIAL?'). Empty string = not reviewed (12 of 326 rows).

fields.name: automated_relevance_label_reference
fields.description: The automated relevance_label from the candidate_2026-07-22_0e794cd9 run, copied alongside the human verdict for direct comparison.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Free-text (Chinese) reviewer observation. Only present on 3 of 326 rows in the source; these are general observations, not per-query notes.
